def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_worth = 1_200_000
    residency_factor = 0.9

    tax_free_threshold = 500_000
    second_bracket_threshold = 1_000_000
    second_bracket_rate = 0.02
    top_bracket_rate = 0.04

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    second_bracket_tax = (
        second_bracket_threshold - tax_free_threshold
    ) * second_bracket_rate

    top_bracket_tax = (
        net_worth - second_bracket_threshold
    ) * top_bracket_rate

    calculated_tax = second_bracket_tax + top_bracket_tax
    adjusted_tax = calculated_tax * residency_factor

    # return answer
    return round(adjusted_tax)
